title: Clopen comparison as a functorial composite
statement: For functors U:A→E, P:E→D, Q:A→B, S:B→C, J:C→B, B₀:B→D, K:C→D, R:A→C, natural transformations β:UP→QB₀, π:Id_B→SJ, c:JB₀→K, d:QS→R determine clopenMateComposite:UP→RK. Its component at F is β_F followed by B₀(π_QF), c_SQF and K(d_F). This is exactly their whiskered composite.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, first proof paragraph; categorical construction implementing its prescribed comparison.

proof.text: Construct the natural transformation by composition and whiskering. Evaluation of composition and whiskering is definitionally the displayed component equation. Marking the definition irreducible keeps concrete functor constructions out of later conversion checks.
